notes: The task's embedded 'Original Replication Scripts' section contained only macOS AppleDouble (._*) resource-fork files, so the real author scripts were read from the mounted data directory (Replication/Code/Manekin_Mitts_Effective_for_Whom_Replication.R, replicate_table_1.R, replicate_table_4.R). Paper Table 1 = package table_1 (weighted lm of outcome on identity_protesters + tactic, wave-1 data); paper Table 2 = package table_4 (unweighted lm on black + group_goal + commitment for US wave 2; identity_protesters + group_goal + commitment for Israel wave 2). Israel identity_protesters is coded 0/1/2; 1 = Ethiopian, 2 = Arab, following the authors' stargazer covariate labels. Respondent counts are nobs() of the perceived-violence regressions. Attempt-1 crashed on a coefficient-name pattern (selection by 'eth'/'arab' text); fixed by selecting identity_protesters1/2. The final values were eyeballed against the claims after the final run (all agree to the printed precision); no script change followed, so there is no claim attempt.
